D1Digital

8-Step Sequencer

Eight steps with pot, LED and switch

A sequencer with eight steps. Each step has an adjustable voltage, an LED and a switch; every clock pulse advances one step.

  • CV 0 to about 10 V (1 V/oct), quantising in firmware
  • Gate output and reset
  • Firmware updates over USB
Width12 HP · 60.7 mm
Height3 U · 128.5 mm
Jacks6
Knobs10
Switches and buttons8
